CustomField.description: Whether an empty HubSpot value is allowed to CLEAR this Salesforce field on the inbound leg. Only consulted for HS_to_SF and Bidirectional fields, and only for a property that came back PRESENT-but-empty -- a property absent from the response is always treated as unknown and skipped. A clear on a non-nillable field is refused regardless of this flag.
CustomField.label: Inbound Clears
